execution_type: proxy contract drafting + collapse audit + falsification design only
surviving_proxy_contract_if_any: P1 Intervention-Sensitive State Update Proxy, constrained by P2 online adaptation and P3 causal model update
intervention_contract_summary: Future task must freeze state deletion, memory deletion, representation freezing, prediction-error injection, counterfactual action substitution, observation perturbation, history-preserving causal perturbation, and online distribution shift.
online_adaptation_contract_summary: Future systems must expose pre-observation state, pre-observation prediction, actual observation, update signal, post-update state, and later policy/action distribution; cheap online controls must receive the same update access.
causal_model_update_constraint_summary: Future probes must distinguish intervention-generated evidence from passive correlations and include causal tables, graph/cache, and model-based controls.
resource_contract_summary: Resource limits are symmetric accounting only; witness and controls must receive comparable budgets and resource advantage alone is not mechanism evidence.
value_state_boundary_summary: value_state = deferred; only non-affective regulatory scalar terms such as prediction-error budget or internal cost estimate are allowed.
trace_replay_contract_summary: Future replay must prove same traces reproduce metrics, non-oracle systems did not access forbidden data, state changed only through allowed update paths, and trace-only replay cannot reproduce both trace and future behavior for a positive claim.
